caption:
Your next ad is already on your phone.

Most service businesses sit on hours of before-and-after footage and never use it.

Three sharper seconds turn that footage into a working ad.

Here's the cut Black Arrow is seeing perform right now for home services, auto, and dental:

Seconds 0-3: show the problem, no talking.

Seconds 3-15: show the fix in motion, let the work carry it.

Seconds 15-20: close on the finished result, one caption line.

Lead your caption with the neighborhood or city, not your business name.

Film this on your next three jobs this week. Whichever cut gets the most saves and shares is the one worth turning into a paid ad.

DM SCALE and Black Arrow will build the ad around it.

#ServiceBusinessGrowth #ContractorMarketing #LocalBusinessMarketing #VideoMarketing #SmallBusinessTips
rationale: Before-and-after reveal and problem-solution hooks are the formats Black Arrow sees working right now for home/service niches, so this turns footage owners already have into a free, specific organic-lead tactic.
